title: Safe accessible full-text retrieval
description: Fetch a saved paper's accessible full-text PDF from canonical provider candidates. Validate public destinations and redirects, enforce PDF signature/size/time limits, retain original bytes in MinIO, and reuse durable ingestion/status/error handling without accepting arbitrary browser URLs.
acceptance_criteria: Stored public candidate download validates redirects/signature/limits and uses ingestion.
test_cases: Stored public candidate download validates redirects/signature/limits and uses ingestion.
verification: Reopened for continued iteration after user feedback. Download/ingestion is not implemented yet.
